routing_warnings.description: The reported Tela Mare 3 colour-layout error concerns a block-colour pareo with a black border and mustard interior, not the Zebra repeat print.
The request to resize the artwork to 130 x 170 cm, or 133 x 173 cm with seam allowance, changes the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The reversed black-border and mustard-interior error concerns a block-colour pareo rather than the diagonal basket-weave print.
The request to change the artwork to 130 × 170 cm, or 133 × 173 cm with seam allowance, changes the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The delivered 133 × 173 cm rescaled files are an implementation claim for the artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The same message separately confirms the 1.5 cm seam allowance, which belongs to the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The client changes the shared finished-artwork dimensions to 130 × 170 cm, or 133 × 173 cm including seam allowance.
The freelancer reports that the rescaled 133 × 173 cm files were delivered.
The reported reversed colour-layout error specifically concerns the block pareo requiring a black border and mustard interior.
